items.text: Dear Hunters,
The first patch is here, and it's a substantial one!
As mentioned earlier this week, please make sure your PC graphics drivers are up to date. Installing the latest drivers may help prevent some crashes and improve overall stability.
Improved environmental rendering and foliage processing across hunting reserves.
Fixed a graphics-related crash that could occur after fast travel on certain GPUs.
Fixed several crashes related to companion and shooting range sequences.
Baying for Wild Pigs: Hunting hounds can now use their baying ability when hunting wild pigs.
Companion Icon Settings: Added separate options to control overhead companion icons and companion notification icons.
Ballistics: Added settings to adjust wind influence, gravity, Coriolis effects, and time scaling.
Animal Calls: Added an option to enable or disable animal calls and updated their display settings.
Added boar caller.
Added urine spray for Feral Pigs.
Improved how the companion responds to nearby wildlife.
Improved animal charging behavior to prevent animals from repeatedly circling the hunter at close range.
Improved bird behavior around bushes and prevented birds from becoming stuck on environmental objects during flight.
Updated animal scoring and genetic potential calculations for more consistent trophy evaluations.
Updated ammunition compatibility for several species across Colorado and Texas.
Prairie dogs can now be retrieved after being shot.
Improved wounded movement and other animal animations.
Improved recoil animations for several firearms, including .22 LR rifles and the Browning T-Bolt.
Improved aiming alignment and reload animations for selected rifles and shotguns.
Corrected projectile air-drag and Coriolis calculations.
Improved image clarity when looking through scopes.
Added an audio countdown to shooting range sequences and adjusted the timing between waves.
Improved vehicle headlights for better visibility at night.
The player now starts in the reserve he last played.
Update the fall damage to be more forgiving.
Updated weather forecasts and hunting-time lighting.
Improved terrain detail, and vegetation rendering.
Removed misplaced vegetation and corrected terrain collisions in Colorado and Texas.
Added small bridges near the Colorado lodge and improved nearby roads and terrain.
Updated various animal models, equipment visuals, and environmental details.
Fixed missing "No scent found" and "No game found" companion notifications.
Fixed companion occasionally entering Stay mode after rapidly entering and exiting vehicles.
Fixed crashes that could occur when a companion exited vehicles or attempted to return to the hunter.
Fixed the companion command wheel occasionally becoming unavailable.
Fixed companion hints continuing after the kennel had already been visited.
Fixed certain contracts failing to recognize eligible animals.
Fixed hunting licenses being removed even when the player had an active contract covering the species.
Fixed low genetic-potential animals not being recognized correctly by some objectives.
Fixed dead animal markers not appearing correctly on the map. These markers are now available on Easy difficulty.
Fixed several animal texture, coloration, and missing-body-part issues.
Fixed animal movement and animation issues around burrows.
Fixed animal age that was not updating.
Fixed birds always spawning with the same age.
Fixed free-look occasionally become stuck after interacting with objects.
Fixed players becoming invulnerable after entering Photo Mode.
Fixed shooting and interaction controls sometimes become unavailable after exiting Photo Mode.
Fixed characters becoming stuck in vehicle driving poses after exiting.
Fixed players occasionally spawning beneath the terrain or inside obstacles when leaving vehicles.
Fixed hunting tutorials highlighting the wrong weapon slot.
Fixed that some calibers were not using the correct visual in the bagging window.
Fixed radio so it doesn’t start playing each time when entering the vehicle.
Fixed settings menu focus issues when applying changes.
Fixed several interface display issues on ultrawide screens and in different languages.
Fixed tents not appearing on the map before discovering watchtowers.
Fixed track clue markers remaining visible at close range in Ranger Mode.
Fixed various floating objects, misplaced foliage, and collision issues across hunting reserves.
Fixed clay targets not always being marked as missed when shots failed to hit them.
Fixed retriever achievement not working.
Known Issue: This patch comes with one known issue. In very rare cases, the game may crash when changing the anti-aliasing and upscaling settings in succession.
Happy Hunting!
